mapper.select: select coalesce(max(header_id),1) from ps_sign_m where org_id = #{orgId}
select coalesce(max(cast(right(sign_no, 4) as unsigned)), 0) from ps_sign_m where org_id = #{orgId} and sign_no like concat(#{prefix}, '%')
mapper.insert: insert into ps_sign_m(ORG_ID, HEADER_ID, SIGN_NO, SIGN_DATE, CUST_ID, IS_SALES, STATUS, CRE_USER, CRE_DATE, VALID_USER, VALID_DATE, LAST_USER, LAST_DATE) values(#{orgId},#{headerId},#{signNo},#{signDate},#{custId},#{isSales},#{status},#{creUser},#{creDate},#{validUser},#{validDate},#{lastUser},#{lastDate})
